title: Purge: Delete forever, Empty Trash, and a daily purge after 30 days
steps: Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K), type trash and press Enter. Select Untitled 3 and press D (Shift+d): it asks first; Cancel keeps it. Press D again and choose Delete forever.
Open Show history of everything: the line says Deleted forever, by you, with no Undo, and the note's old text can't be opened.
Move a couple of notes to Trash with :trash, then use Empty Trash at the top of the Trash view: it asks, then deletes them all forever.
On a phone, in Trash, swipe a row left: it goes red, and letting go asks before deleting forever.
